compiled_state.title: Enforce-flip: swap merge-pipeline-checks -> review-gate on the live main ruleset
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want to flip the live main ruleset to require `review-gate` (swapping out the no-op merge-pipeline-checks) so that the non-negotiable requirement is finally ruleset-enforced end-to-end.

Plan refs: A-5 (enforce-flip); A-5 HARD PREREQUISITE GATE; §2.10.1 runbook. THE ONLY HARD-TO-REVERSE STEP — affects every contributor's promotions. Gated; runbook-driven.

HARD PREREQUISITE GATE (do NOT start until ALL green — verify explicitly):
1. exit-78 fail-closed fix landed + verified RED in enforce in all 3 carriers (story 1).
2. R8 _live_round_trip fail-closed under enforce + PAT scope/expiry verified (story 1).
3. CF-6 ledger convergent (story 2); S-11 admin-exemption ledger (story 3).
4. review-gate warn-mode shadow shows ZERO false BLOCKs on real PR2 traffic (story 5).
5. allowlist tightening verified (story 6).
6. E7 GO (dangling enforce-ready) OR the documented advisory fallback applied (story 4).
7. durable admin PAT secured (V0.8).

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: required-checks.txt swap — merge-pipeline-checks OUT, review-gate IN (retain llm-review). (SC3)
- DD2: live main ruleset 15629023 re-provisioned (admin PAT) with the SAME swap, atomic IN+OUT in one provision call, in the E6-verified order. (SC3)
- DD3: required-checks.txt consumer sweep applied (provision-ruleset.sh, validate-required-checks.sh, promote-ruleset-required.sh, update-required-checks-manifest.sh, github-bootstrap.sh + their tests). (SC3/SC6)
- DD4: flip DSO_*_MODE to enforce for the gate; decommission redundant individually-required backstops as subsumed (do not add coverage/dangling individually — I-4). (SC1)

RUNBOOK (mandatory): land the swap PR with NO other PR2 in flight — ruleset-invariants.yml fires on every PR to main and the live provision is global, so R8 goes RED repo-wide during the live<->file skew window. Quiesce other promotions, provision live, land the file-PR fast.

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- E6': live drift (review-gate IN/merge-pipeline-checks OUT but required-checks.txt NOT yet updated, and the reverse) -> a required check actually goes RED. Settles the self-wedge ordering.
- E6: atomic provision/assert ordering — out-of-order wedges ruleset-design-invariants; correct order green.
- Post-flip live: an allowlisted-only PR2 with un-reviewed content is BLOCKED; a clean fully-reviewed PR2 passes; a real combined-state issue is BLOCKED; a ticket-only commit passes; no false wedge. [E2/E3/E8]

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if the swap wedges any legitimate promotion post-flip, execute the documented rollback (re-provision live back to the prior 12-context set; revert the required-checks.txt swap) IMMEDIATELY — do not leave the team wedged while debugging.

Maps to SC1, SC3. DEPENDS ON stories 1,2,3,4,5,6 ALL verified.

comments.body:
AMENDMENT — HARD PREREQUISITE GATE additions from the coherence review (2026-06-04). The existing 7-item gate UNDER-COUNTS these flip-blockers surfaced by dogfooding 29e7 -> main (PR1 #631 -> PR2 #632):
- P8 OVERRIDE-PROPAGATION (owned by 3ebb DD4): FP-recovery/admin-bypass SHAs must be ael_append'd to the admin-exemption ledger AND the coverage CI must consult it (DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER) — else every FP-recovery double-wedges subsequent PRs under enforce. CODE-VERIFIED dead in CI today.
- P9 cca8 linear-history LANDED — promote from a bare blocks-link to an EXPLICIT checklist item (eliminates the merge-commit class by construction).
- P10 0f17 version-bump KEEP LANDED — stale-base conflict; confirmed LIVE at PR2 #632.
- P11 4ba5 FIXED — merge-commit empty-net-diff no longer false-blocks.
Do NOT flip enforce until P8 + (0cd7 with 4ba5) are green. DEFERRABLE past the flip: 3ebb DD2/DD3 (durable-resume + escalation are MTTR, not SC-bearing) and 830c A-7 UX.

comments.body:
REFINEMENT (round-1 canonical panel, 2026-06-04) — make the enforce-flip prerequisite a MACHINE gate, not prose (fitness + historical TOP recommendation). The 7-item + P8-P11 gate is currently a human checklist; a flip executed on a prerequisite merely BELIEVED green is the highest-consequence false-green in the epic (it is the security invariant itself).
ADD a required CI check "no-dormant-security-check" that fails CLOSED if any security check is built-but-unwired — e.g. the admin-exemption consult path unreachable (DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER unset), or review-convergence-check.sh present-but-not-required. 3ee4 CANNOT flip while this audit is red. This would have caught DD4's dead ledger mechanically rather than via a dogfooding session.
Explicit checklist items to mechanize: (P8a) admin-exemption LIVENESS test green (3ebb DD4 (i)); (P8b) .closure-key provisioned to the coverage-invariant CI job (G-A); (P9) cca8 linear-history LANDED (promote from the soft blocks-link to a hard checklist gate — if 3ee4 flips before cca8, every PR2 exercises the clean-merge exemption + 4ba5 empty-net-diff path under ENFORCE = false-red wedge); (P11) 0cd7 DD8 net-diff fix LANDED (mitigates the merge-commit class if cca8 slips).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: ENFORCE-FLIP GATE ADDITION P8c (canonical panel, 2026-06-04): override-propagation must reach the PROVENANCE consumer (verify-session-provenance -> llm-review dispatch), not just coverage-invariant — else under enforce EVERY FP-recovery is a guaranteed DOUBLE-wedge (review-sub-pr on PR1 + llm-review re-review on PR2; proven live on #634). P8c = 3ebb DD4 unit 5 landed AND its 5 HARD SECURITY CONDITIONS met (C1 code-enforced opus-gate in fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh; C2 honor only exempt_by=fp-recovery; C3 closure-key boundary as a control + key-independent backstop or authorizing ADR; C4 no-dormant P-AEL-PROVENANCE predicate; C5 staged-* not force-review). CRITICAL SEQUENCING: provisioning the closure-key to CI (G-A / P8b) arms BOTH the coverage AND provenance ledger consults simultaneously, so G-A MUST be gated on C1-C3 — do NOT provision the key until the opus-gate is code-enforced, or it opens signed self-laundering past llm-review.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: P8c HARD-PREREQUISITE update (ADR-0022, 2026-06-04): the 'S-11 admin-exemption ledger' prerequisite is SUPERSEDED. Admin exemption is now IDENTITY-BASED — a covering PR merged by a designated bypass-actor (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, server-set merged_by) is reviewed-equivalent in both Goal-1 gates; no signing key, no ledger. New enforce-flip prereq: P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT (no-dormant-security-check asserts a bypass-actor resolves) green, AND the configured bypass set matches the live ruleset bypass actor (admin-run actor-identity assertion — ADR-0022 follow-up, since ruleset-design-invariants locks only the can_bypass:never OUTCOME, not the actor identity). Former gap G-A (provision closure-key to CI) is RETIRED (no key). C1/C2/C3 obsolete. Forge-proof by construction (agent is current_user_can_bypass:never).
